en.wal.hero.title:
POH
Wallet.
en.wal.hero.sub: Your AI compute earnings. Your POH balance. Watch your node earn — right in your pocket.
en.wal.balance.title:
Your compute earnings.
Always current.
en.wal.balance.desc: Balance updates directly from your running node. Each solved AI task adds to your balance — watch it grow block by block, in real time.
en.wal.balance.f1t: Live earnings pulled from your miner node
en.wal.balance.f1d: Connects to any running node on the decentralized compute network
en.wal.balance.f2d: See how many AI tasks your node solved — and what it earned
en.wal.balance.f3d: Peer count and latency shown in-app. Auto-switches on disconnect.
en.wal.chat.title:
Your AI.
Right in your pocket.
en.wal.chat.desc: The same LLM that earns you POH is available as a personal AI assistant — no subscription, no API key, no cloud.
en.wal.chat.f1d: Full LLM in your pocket — ask anything, anytime, even offline
en.wal.chat.f2d: Runs entirely on your device — no data sent to any server, ever
en.wal.chat.f3d: Powered by compute you already own — no subscriptions, no rate limits
en.wal.scanner.title:
Scan any address.
In seconds.
en.wal.scanner.desc: Paste any wallet address and get an AI verdict — the same decentralized compute network your node serves processes the task. No central server, no API key.
en.wal.scanner.f1t: On-device LLM inference. Real AI verdict.
en.wal.scanner.f1d: Processed by local LLMs across the compute network — not a cloud API
en.wal.scanner.f2d: Routes through the peer network — no single point of failure
en.wal.scanner.f3d: Dispute a verdict. Your correction trains the network's brain.
en.wal.send.title:
Send POH.
In seconds.
en.wal.send.desc: Full peer-to-peer POH transfers between any addresses on the network. No exchange, no bridge, no intermediary.
en.wal.send.f1d: Paste an address, scan a QR code, or pick from history
en.wal.send.f2d: Transactions broadcast via P2P gossip — no central server
en.wal.send.f3d: Get alerted when a reward arrives or a transfer confirms
en.wal.node.title:
Connects to your node.
Not a company.
en.wal.node.desc: The wallet connects directly to the decentralized compute network. No accounts, no servers. Just you, your node, and your earnings.
en.wal.node.c1d: Built-in node list to get started. Add your own node address to connect directly to your own AI compute machine.
en.wal.node.c2d: Pings all nodes in parallel and selects the fastest. Automatic failover when a node drops.
en.wal.node.c3d: Running a node? Point the wallet at your own machine for full custody of your balance and earnings.
en.wal.download.title:
Download.
Run. Earn.
en.wal.download.desc: Sideload the APK directly. No Play Store. No tracking. Your keys, your rewards.
en.wal.foot.tag: PoH Miner Wallet — companion app for the decentralized AI compute network

Wallet.
